messages:
yasmin: Quick thought 1 1 1 Can we pilot a 'Mini Hero' pop-up booth at next Friday's town hall? 5 minute flow: nominate on paper, hand someone a sticker, small enamel pin drop. low lift, high delight.
ori: Love this. What are the must-haves logistically? table, tablecloth, sign, pins, stickers, pens, volunteer shift coverage?
jamie: From ops POV: table and tablecloth available, we can borrow the mic stand for signage. Pins + stickers need ordering. I can handle onsite setup.
yasmin: I'll draft a one-paragraph blurb for the town-hall agenda and a 2-line slack announcement.
spot-bot: Reminder: physical swag orders must be placed at least 7 business days in advance for standard turnaround. Rush available (+48hr) at extra cost.
ori: Budget estimate? small enamel pins (100) ~$260, sticker sheet (200) $45, printed 4x6 cards $12, signage materials $20. Shipping + tax ~ $40. Total ~ $377.
finance: That looks fine as a culture expense under Events Q3. Please attach invoice to the card after purchase.
jamie: Volunteers: I'm proposing two 20-min shifts during town hall (before doors, mid-break) plus one 30-min packdown. Who can help?
yasmin: I can do the 20-min before doors and the announcement handoff. Also I can write the short nomination prompt to keep it focused.
ori: I can cover mid-break and manage the sticker station. Also happy to coordinate order and vendor proof for pins.
jamie: I'll run packdown and return any leftover swag to central stash. Can someone create a quick sign that says "Mini Hero Nominations: 1-2 sentences, why they helped you"? Keep it friendly.
spot-bot: ACTION: submit final pin design by Tue 12:00 for standard production.
yasmin: I'll post the sign mock and the announcement copy here by Monday morning. Also thinking of a QR code for the digital form for folks who prefer not to write.
ori: QR makes sense. I'll generate one and place it on the sign + the back of the cards.
jamie: One small ops note: please avoid glitter confetti near the AV cabling. :grimacing:
yasmin: noted. no glitter. maybe biodegradable confetti in a sealed release bag if we want pomp.
ori: For accessibility: we'll have a volunteer offer to transcribe any spoken nominations into the form for folks who ask. Include that line on the sign.
yasmin: checklist for team: pin design approval (all by Tue noon), place order (ori), print cards + signs (jamie), volunteer schedule (yam table sign-ups), slack blurb (yasmin). I'll convert this thread into a tiny Trello card.
finance: Once payment is processed, share receipt and expense code. Thanks!
spot-bot: Nice! Post-event: collect 3 quick quotes from participants for a micro social post.
yasmin: Great idea. We'll capture a photo and a quote or two. Alright team — I'll post the mock and the signup link Monday. Thanks all! :seedling:
